ui.Az Idegen Kórus: a meteorokkal érkezett: The Alien Choir: spores that came with the meteors have possessed the ant-like kethri people. ui.A Hét Út Szövetsége: dingónép folyóváros: The Alliance of the Seven Roads: a dingo people of river towns, wandering communities and road-songs on the red plains and in the eucalyptus forests. ui.Aureth népe: az Égszakadás éterbetegségé: The people of Aureth: Ordan, the Hand that Holds, carried those dying of the ether sickness of the Skyfall into machine bodies. Real human souls in steel – no new members are born to them, so every resource is a matter of life. Their numbers come from soul reactors; Fabricators repair the machines, and soul callers raise a legion from the fallen.

ui.A kút alján fényes kőpor és páncéldarabo: At the bottom of the well: shining stone dust and pieces of armour. Kethri armour?

ui.Szelai: A hálózatot én terveztem. Én tud: Szelai: I designed the network. I know where to cut it.
ui.Szelai: A tiszta érc mentheti az életüke: Szelai: Pure ore can save their lives. Unrefined ore kills them – and us too.
ui.Szelai: A torony nélkül nincs pajzs. Teg: Szelai: Without the tower there is no shield. Do what your grandfathers did: line up.
ui.Szelai: Parancs. A tanács nem kérdez – é: Szelai: An order. The council does not ask – and neither do I.
ui.Szerezd vissza az ércet – de ne ölj több: Recover the ore – but do not kill more Ursans than you must.
ui.Szerezz vissza 200 csillagércet, és szor: Recover 200 star-ore, and drive out the unlicensed miners.
ui.Szőj új fonalakat, emelj Szívgombákat, é: Weave new threads, raise Heart Fungi, and restore the flow of nourishment.
ui.Tarts ki – és ne feledd: minden elesett: Hold out – and remember: every fallen anchor is a person lost forever.
ui.Tarts ki, amíg a hálózat leválik: Hold out until the network is severed
ui.Tarts ki, amíg a hálózat leválik. A vesz: Hold out until the network is severed. The loss is permanent.
ui.Tartsd a műhelyt a teszt végéig: Hold the workshop until the end of the test
ui.Tartsd a rakpartot, amíg a csónakok el n: Hold the quay until the boats carry the families away, and lead out the last group too.
ui.Tartsd a vonalat, amíg a menekülők eltűn: Hold the line until the refugees are gone
ui.Tartsd a várost az átállásig: Hold the city until the switch-over
ui.Tartsd ki, amíg Mór kiolvassa az emlékek: Hold out while Mór reads the memories
ui.Tava a város kapujában áll, kezében crof: Tava stands at the city gate, croftian armour pieces in hand. „See what is coming from the mountains before you tear down our walls.” The order of the Council of the Nine Steps is clear.
ui.Tava egy megsebzett ellenséges lényt is: Tava also captures a wounded enemy creature…
ui.Tava ekkor már bizonyítékot hoz a crofti: By now Tava brings proof of the croftian spread…
ui.Tava elesett – a hadjárat nem folytatódh: Tava has fallen – the campaign cannot go on without her.
Tava's scouts wait on the other side.
ui.Tava, mint a Hét Út követe, rendet tesz:: Tava, as envoy of the Seven Roads, restores order: secure the stores and the roads, and stop the raiders.
ui.Tava: Az úténekek szerint ez a vidék min: Tava: According to the road-songs this land always had sweet water. Something has changed beneath it.
ui.Tava: Előbb a raktárak. Egy vásárváros,: Tava: The stores first. A market town with nothing to sell soon becomes a battlefield.
ui.Tava: Ezen az úton a következő télen is: Tava: Food must arrive along this road next winter too.
ui.Tava: Ha az egyik várost mentjük előbb,: Tava: If we save one town first, the other will never forgive us. If neither, both fall.
ui.Tava: Nem a falakat védjük. Az embereket: Tava: We are not defending the walls. We are defending the people.
ui.Tava: „Nézd meg, mi jön a hegyekből, mie: Tava: „See what is coming from the mountains before you break our walls!”
ui.Termelj ki 250 csillagércet – a jarl ezt: Mine 250 star-ore – the jarl demands it – but beware: the croftians appear behind the lines.
ui.Tisztítsd meg a fészket, amely mindkét v: Clear the nest that threatens both towns; the old road-singer says the brood mother is the source.
ui.Több fiatal (Karmos) jön veled – sebezhe: More of the young (Clawlings) come with you – more vulnerable, but more lives.
Break the defences of the terraces.
ui.Tüskeköpők csatlakoznak – az út biztonsá: Spine Spitters join – the road is safer.
ui.Ugyanaz az érc fűtené a menekülteket és: The same ore would warm the refugees and charge Aureth's anchors.
ui.Utolsó önálló mondata: „A többiek még be: Its last independent sentence: „The others are still within us.”
ui.V. Az isten, aki nem enged el: V. The God Who Will Not Let Go
ui.VI. A sokaság neve: VI. The Name of the Multitude
ui.Vedd el tőle a bányát: döntsd le a Nagyt: Take the mine from him: topple his Great Hall.
ui.Vezesd ki a felszabadultakat a Visszhang: Lead the freed ones out to the Echo Gate.
ui.Vezesd ki a lakókat (Kőfaragókat), és ta: Lead out the inhabitants (Stonecarvers), and hold the line.
ui.Vezesd vissza a vizet, tartsd fenn az en: Bring back the water, keep the power up, escort the rescue teams. You cannot save everyone.
ui.Vezess 10 menekültet a déli úthoz: Lead 10 refugees to the southern road
ui.Vezess 6 Gyűjtögetőt a nyugati kapuhoz: Lead 6 Foragers to the western gate
ui.Vezess 6 civilt (Gyűjtögetőt) a biztonsá: Lead 6 civilians (Foragers) to the safe shore
ui.Vezess 6 felszabadult Karmost a Visszhan: Lead 6 freed Clawlings to the Echo Gate
ui.Vezess 8 lakót (Kőfaragót) a déli kapuho: Lead 8 inhabitants (Stonecarvers) to the southern gate
ui.Vezess 8 menekültet a hágó túloldalára;: Lead 8 refugees to the far side of the pass; Tava walks at the head of the convoy.
ui.Vidd vissza a feljegyzéseket a táborba: Take the records back to the camp
ui.Vigyázz: a sötétben páncélos, ismeretlen: Beware: armoured, unknown creatures move in the dark.
ui.Visszatekintés: a Kórus haderejét Keth p: Flashback: you command the Choir's forces through Keth's command node. Then Keth's memories disturb the alien interpretation.
ui.Vásárnap. A téren tömeg, zene, csereáru: Market day. A crowd on the square, music, goods to trade – then the ground caves in.
ui.Wullof, ursan és kethri menekültek egyet: Wullof, Ursan and kethri refugees in a single convoy heading north. Ragna allows passage only.
ui.Állíts fel 3 Szellemtotemet az út mentén: Raise 3 Spirit Totems along the road
ui.Éhező klánharcosok rontanak az erődre!: Starving clan warriors storm the fort!
ui.Építs 2 Lélekreaktort az energiaellátásh: Build 2 Soul Reactors for the power supply
ui.Építs Lélekreaktorokat, és termelj ki el: Build Soul Reactors, and mine enough ore for both peoples.
ui.Észak: Ragna megkereste a menekülteket,: North: Ragna sought out the refugees she once sent away. Not all of them survived the winter.
ui.Észak: azok, akiket Ragna a magtárak ide: North: those Ragna let in during the granaries now guard the pass with her.
ui.Új parancs: egy Wullof város ellen, amel: A new order: against a Wullof city that refines its ore properly – it just does not recognise elven control.
ui.Űzd el a bányászokat védő harcosokat (10: Drive off the warriors protecting the miners (10)
„Give them to me. I will not let a single one go.”
ui.…aztán egy város gondnokát, aki kétségbe: …then a city's caretaker, desperately trying to remember the names of his children.
Play the story missions in order.
ui.A novellák önálló pályái – bármikor, bár: Standalone novella missions – play at any time, in any order.
ui.Csata gépi ellenfelek ellen, saját beáll: Battle AI opponents with custom settings.
ui.Játék a helyi hálózaton (LAN): létrehozá: Create or join a local network (LAN) game.
ui.A világ, a népek és a novellák – olvasni: The world, its peoples and novellas – illustrated stories.
ui.Profil választása, létrehozása és statis: Select or create a profile and view statistics.
ui.Modok engedélyezése, letiltása és betölt: Enable mods, disable mods and change their load order.
ui.Figyelem: Python-szkriptet futtat – csak: Warning: runs Python scripts – install only from trusted sources.
ui.Nincs engedélyezett mod – az alapjáték f: No mods enabled – running the base game.
ui.Változás van: mentéskor a játék újratölt: Unsaved changes: saving reloads the game data.
ui.Nincs telepített mod. A modok a játék mo: No mods installed. Place mods in mods/<name>/mod.json; see docs/MODDING.md.
ui.Még nincs zene. A számok helye: assets/m: No music yet. Place tracks in assets/music (per mission: assets/music/kuldetesek/<mission>/).

oon_kapuorzes.name: Gate Guard
oon_kapuorzes.desc: Stands guard by a building without moving, granting it +3 armor (up to +6). After activation, the first hit against a mounted unit slows it by 35% for 1.2 seconds.

cro_merges_tuskek.name: Poisonous Spikes
cro_merges_tuskek.desc: A Tendril Servant places this in 2 seconds. Non-Croftian ground units crossing the spikes are slowed by 40% and poisoned for 4 damage per second. This includes your own and allied minor-faction units. Each tile has 40 HP. Fire and poison deal full damage. Other attacks deal 20% damage and poison non-Croftian attackers. Up to 16 tiles. Spike Field research expands placement to 2×2.

elves.name: Grey Elves
elves.desc: The Cities of Stone and Star: stepped temple-cities bound together by the Council of the Nine Steps. Few, long-trained warriors with meteorite shields; buildings are summoned into the fields of the resonance obelisks.

ursan.name: Ursans
ursan.desc: The Empire of the Northern Oaths: jarldoms bound by oath, longhalls mixed with yurts, barley farmsteads. They wear no helmets, at most a loincloth, and fight with great flat plank shields. Halls and towers take in garrisons (in an alarm the settlers hide inside too); their numbers are fed by farmsteads. Shield walls and ice-age war beasts.

croftian.name: Croftians
croftian.desc: The Alien Choir: spores that came with the meteors have possessed the ant-like kethri people. Every unit hatches in parallel from the Hive's larvae, Clawlings mutate into armoured beetles inside cocoons, and a living enemy that falls on the deep may hatch as a new Clawling.

wullof.name: Wullof
wullof.desc: The Alliance of the Seven Roads: a dingo people of river towns, wandering communities and road-songs on the red plains and in the eucalyptus forests. Their camps can be packed up and pitched elsewhere; emu herds provide the population, they are stronger as a pack, and every kill brings wood to the tribe.
wullof.tagline: Nomad camps • pack strength • hunting spoils

mycel.name: Mycelians
mycel.desc: The people of the Deep Gardens: individual fungal persons bound together by an underground web of threads (the name is a working title). Their buildings only work when linked to a Heart Fungus by spore threads, but resources can be dropped at any of them; three Puffballs merge into a Giant Puffball.

imperium.name: Iron Empire
imperium.desc: The people of Aureth: Ordan, the Hand that Holds, carried those dying of the ether sickness of the Skyfall into machine bodies. Real human souls in steel – no new members are born to them, so every resource is a matter of life. Their numbers come from soul reactors; Fabricators repair the machines, and soul callers raise a legion from the fallen.
imperium.tagline: Soul calling • machine repair • siege • soul reactors

vadon.name: The Wild
vadon.desc: Since the Bright Rain, ether-soaked creatures of the wild guard the crystal deposits and the treasures.

cro_csapszolga.name: Tendril Thrall
cro_csapszolga.desc: Worker. Turns into the building it makes (is consumed).

cro_karmos.name: Clawling
cro_karmos.desc: Cheap, fast swarm unit. Two hatch from one larva.

cro_tuskekopo.name: Spine Spitter
cro_tuskekopo.desc: Spits bone spines at ground and air targets.

cro_savkopo.name: Acid Spitter
cro_savkopo.desc: Living artillery. Long-range acid sacs, splash damage, bonus against buildings.

cro_agyfalo.name: Mind Eater
cro_agyfalo.desc: Psionic horror. Unleashes the mist of madness on the enemy.

cro_szarnyas_rem.name: Winged Dread
cro_szarnyas_rem.desc: A flying predator on membrane wings.

cro_csapos_horror.name: Tendril Horror
cro_csapos_horror.desc: Giant of the deep. Its tendrils crush several foes at once.

cro_hos_keth.name: Keth
cro_hos_keth.desc: The memory-keeper of a possessed kethri city; a command node of the Choir – yet the old self has not vanished.

cro_pancelbogar.name: Armoured Beetle
cro_pancelbogar.desc: A Clawling mutated into an armoured assault beast. Only created by mutation.

cro_guboj.name: Cocoon
cro_guboj.desc: A mutating unit – a vulnerable but armoured shell.

cro_szemhordozo.name: Eye Bearer
cro_szemhordozo.desc: A floating eye-sac: sees far, and carries the Choir's numbers (+8).

cro_hos_vor.name: Vor-Uthul
cro_hos_vor.desc: The Master of Mutation: hatches larvae from his own body and grows chitin armour.

cro_hos_ssarha.name: Ssarha, Voice of the Swarm
cro_hos_ssarha.desc: The voice of the Choir: binds the swarm into one will and stitches its wounds.

cro_kaptar.name: Hive
cro_kaptar.desc: Living main building. Raises larvae (max. 3); every unit hatches here – in parallel.

cro_tapgomba.name: Feeding Fungus
cro_tapgomba.desc: A nourishing fungus colony: spreads the deep far and heals the swarm.

cro_tuskeverem.name: Spine Pit
cro_tuskeverem.desc: Enables Spine Spitters and Acid Spitters.

cro_agyszentely.name: Brain Sanctum
cro_agyszentely.desc: Enables the Mind Eater and the Tendril Horror.

cro_tuskes_gyoker.name: Spined Root
cro_tuskes_gyoker.desc: Defensive building against ground and air targets.

kethri_tojaskamra.name: Kethri Egg Chamber
kethri_tojaskamra.desc: Uninfected kethri eggs – the next generation. Protect it!

cro_korus_kut.name: Choir Well
cro_korus_kut.desc: A throbbing well of sound: from here speak the Choir's heroes – Keth, Vor-Uthul and Ssarha.

elf_kofarago.name: Stonecarver
elf_kofarago.desc: Worker. Summons the buildings, then goes back to gathering.

elf_tollas_harcos.name: Feathered Warrior
elf_tollas_harcos.desc: Elite infantry fighting with an obsidian-edged club.

elf_jade_ijasz.name: Jade Archer
elf_jade_ijasz.desc: Ranged unit, shoots ground and air targets.

elf_raptor_lovas.name: Raptor Rider
elf_raptor_lovas.desc: Fast rider on a tailless feathered lizard. Bonus against ranged units.

elf_napszoro.name: Sunscatter Priest
elf_napszoro.desc: Meteorite mage. Calls a sun storm upon the enemy.

elf_quetzal.name: Quetzal
elf_quetzal.desc: Feathered flying dinosaur. Strikes at everything.

elf_tollas_rex.name: Crested Rex
elf_tollas_rex.desc: A giant dinosaur with a feather crown, archers on its back. Area bite.

elf_hos_szelai.name: Szelai
elf_hos_szelai.desc: A resonance architect made a commander by fate. Builds and breaks networks; calls a sun storm.

elf_csillagdardas.name: Star Spear
elf_csillagdardas.desc: Throws star-ore tipped spears – long reach, hits air targets too.

elf_obszidian_veto.name: Obsidian Hurler
elf_obszidian_veto.desc: The stonecarvers' siege engine: hurls blocks of obsidian, especially strong against buildings.

elf_jadeor.name: Jade Guardian
elf_jadeor.desc: A jade statue brought to life (summoned).

elf_hos_itzcoatl.name: Itzcoatl
elf_hos_itzcoatl.desc: The feathered warlord of the Nine Steps. A melee fighter at the head of the army.

elf_hos_xochi.name: Xochi
elf_hos_xochi.desc: Master of resonance: awakens jade guardians and heals.

elf_napszentely.name: Sun Sanctuary
elf_napszentely.desc: Stepped pyramid, main building. Drop-off, trains Stonecarvers.

elf_obeliszk.name: Sun Obelisk
elf_obeliszk.desc: +8 population. Radiates a power field – elf buildings only work inside it.

elf_harcos_csarnok.name: Hall of Warriors
elf_harcos_csarnok.desc: Trains Feathered Warriors and Jade Archers.

elf_obszidian_muhely.name: Obsidian Workshop
elf_obszidian_muhely.desc: Weapon and shield upgrades; builds Star Spears and Obsidian Hurlers.

elf_raptor_karam.name: Raptor Pen
elf_raptor_karam.desc: Raises Raptor Riders and Crested Rexes.

elf_csillagvizsgalo.name: Observatory
elf_csillagvizsgalo.desc: Trains Sunscatter Priests and studies the wisdom of the stars.

elf_jade_oszlop.name: Jade Pillar
elf_jade_oszlop.desc: Defensive tower against ground and air targets.

elf_napkapu.name: Sun Gate
elf_napkapu.desc: Hero-summoning temple gate: Szelai, Itzcoatl and Xochi.

imp_fabrikator.name: Fabricator
imp_fabrikator.desc: Spider-like worker machine. Builds, gathers, and repairs buildings and machines (right-click a damaged machine).

imp_legios.name: Legionary
imp_legios.desc: A legionary soul locked in a small walker body, with scutum and gladius.

imp_ballistarius.name: Ballistarius
imp_ballistarius.desc: Small machine with a shoulder-mounted crossbow.

imp_szellemidezo.name: Soul Caller
imp_szellemidezo.desc: Soul-saving machine priest. Rescues soul anchors from the corpses of the battlefield and raises ghost legionaries.

imp_centurio.name: Centurion Mech
imp_centurio.desc: Medium walker mech with a rotary cannon.

imp_kolosszus.name: Colossus
imp_kolosszus.desc: Giant siege mech. In siege mode it cannot move, but shoots further and harder.

imp_szellemlegios.name: Ghost Legionary
imp_szellemlegios.desc: The soul of a fallen warrior, bound to the Soul Caller's will.

imp_szellemkolosszus.name: Ghost Colossus
imp_szellemkolosszus.desc: The soul of a fallen giant.

imp_hos_livia.name: Livia Varr
imp_hos_livia.desc: Once a physician, now an officer of the legion that rescues soul anchors.

imp_hos_nera.name: Nera
imp_hos_nera.desc: Livia's daughter: put into a machine body as a child; seventy years of experience, but by imperial law still a minor.

imp_onager.name: Onager Mech
imp_onager.desc: Four-legged throwing engine: long range, against buildings and groups.

imp_hos_cassius.name: Legate Cassius Ferrum
imp_hos_cassius.desc: Commander of the Seventh Legion in a heavy machine body: charge, discipline and the wrath of Ordan.

imp_forum.name: Forum
imp_forum.desc: Colonnaded square with a steaming engine house. Drop-off, builds Fabricators.

imp_reaktor.name: Soul Reactor
imp_reaktor.desc: +10 population – gives soul energy to the machines.

imp_ontode.name: Foundry
imp_ontode.desc: Casts Centurion Mechs, Onagers and Colossi.

imp_gepisten_templom.name: Temple of Ordan
imp_gepisten_templom.desc: Shrine of the network of Ordan, the Hand that Holds. Ordains Soul Callers, researches upgrades.

imp_panteon.name: Pantheon
imp_panteon.desc: The hall of the rescued heroes: Livia, Nera and Cassius.

myc_sporaszedo.name: Spore Gatherer
myc_sporaszedo.desc: Worker. Can drop its load at any building linked to the network.

myc_pofeteg.name: Puffball
myc_pofeteg.desc: Cheap, hopping fungus creature. A poison spore cloud bursts out when it dies. Three merge into a Giant Puffball.

myc_tuskegomba_lovesz.name: Spinecap Shooter
myc_tuskegomba_lovesz.desc: Fires poisonous spore spines at ground and air targets.

myc_kalapos_or.name: Capped Guard
myc_kalapos_or.desc: An armoured fungus warrior with a thick cap.

myc_alomsaman.name: Dreamcap Shaman
myc_alomsaman.desc: Binds an area with roots and paralyses the enemy.

myc_oriaspofeteg.name: Giant Puffball
myc_oriaspofeteg.desc: A giant merged from three Puffballs. A huge spore blast when it dies.

myc_lebego_pofeteg.name: Floating Puffball
myc_lebego_pofeteg.desc: A gas-filled floating fungus body; scatters spore rain.

myc_hos_mor.name: Mór
myc_hos_mor.desc: A young memory-gardener carrying fragments of a damaged memory garden inside him. Heals and studies infection.

myc_rothaszto.name: Rotter
myc_rothaszto.desc: A decaying fungus body: rots its foes in melee and releases a poison spore cloud when it dies.

myc_hos_gyokeranya.name: The Root Mother
myc_hos_gyokeranya.desc: Body of the ancient mycelium: puts down roots, binds, and shakes the earth.

myc_hos_sporin.name: Sporin the Decayer
myc_hos_sporin.desc: Wanderer of decay: its spines rot, its cloak is a spore cloud.

myc_szivgomba.name: Heart Fungus
myc_szivgomba.desc: Heart of the network: a small main building and defensive tower in one. +6 population (and +1 for every linked building of the network), raises Spore Gatherers, shoots spores. Any number can be built.

myc_sporafonal.name: Spore Thread
myc_sporafonal.desc: Network node: links buildings to the Heart Fungus.

myc_termotest.name: Fruiting Body
myc_termotest.desc: Grows Puffballs, Rotters and Capped Guards.

myc_emlekfa.name: Memory Tree
myc_emlekfa.desc: The tree of forgotten names: calls Mór, the Root Mother and Sporin.

urs_telepes.name: Settler
urs_telepes.desc: Worker. Builds (stays until it is done), repairs, gathers.

urs_pajzshordozo.name: Shieldbearer
urs_pajzshordozo.desc: Backbone of the Ursan army. Shield wall: absorbs most ranged damage.

urs_szigonyvezo.name: Harpooner
urs_szigonyvezo.desc: Early anti-air: harpoons hit ground and air targets, dealing bonus damage against flyer-type and large targets.

urs_runapap.name: Rune Priest
urs_runapap.desc: Healer. Automatically patches up wounded warriors.

urs_kardfogu.name: Sabretooth Rider
urs_kardfogu.desc: Fast warrior riding a sabretooth tiger. Charge ability.

urs_mammut.name: War Mammoth
urs_mammut.desc: Woolly mammoth with stone throwers on its back. Splash damage, bonus against buildings.

urs_hos_ragna.name: Ragna Stoneshoulder
urs_hos_ragna.desc: Commander of a border fort. Her shield protects the one beside her first.

urs_dardaor.name: Spear Guard
urs_dardaor.desc: Defender with a long spear – excellent against cavalry and large beasts.

urs_ostromszan.name: Siege Sled
urs_ostromszan.desc: A stone thrower mounted on a sled, against buildings.

urs_hos_hjalmar.name: Hjalmar Frostseer
urs_hos_hjalmar.desc: A seer keeping the memory of the ice age: frost, storm and slowing.

urs_hos_bjarka.name: Bjarka, Lord of Beasts
urs_hos_bjarka.desc: Hunter and beast tamer: calls sabretooth tigers and mammoths to battle.

urs_nagyterem.name: Great Hall
urs_nagyterem.desc: Carved longhall, main building. Drop-off, trains Settlers.

urs_hosszuhaz.name: Longhouse
urs_hosszuhaz.desc: Fortified longhouse: garrison of 4, the settlers' refuge in an alarm.

urs_fatelep.name: Lumber Yard
urs_fatelep.desc: Drop-off for wood, stone and meteorite.

urs_harcosok_haza.name: House of Warriors
urs_harcosok_haza.desc: Trains Shieldbearers, Spear Guards and Harpooners. Harpooners provide early anti-air defense.

urs_runakovacs.name: Rune Forge
urs_runakovacs.desc: Trains Rune Priests and Siege Sleds, upgrades weapons and armour.

urs_vadak_karama.name: Beast Pen
urs_vadak_karama.desc: Raises Sabretooth Riders and War Mammoths.

urs_eskufa.name: Oath Tree
urs_eskufa.desc: An ancient ash under which the jarls swear their oaths: Ragna, Hjalmar and Bjarka.

urs_tanya.name: Farmstead
urs_tanya.desc: Barley field, sheds and hay barns: the jarldom lives off it. +10 population.

vad_kristalybogar.name: Crystal Beetle
vad_kristalybogar.desc: A beetle grown huge from star-ore; crystals grow on its shell.

vad_hamufarkas.name: Ash Wolf
vad_hamufarkas.desc: A pack beast living in the ash of the impact.

vad_eterliderc.name: Ether Wisp
vad_eterliderc.desc: A freely wandering knot of ether – once perhaps a soul.

vad_kotroll.name: Stone Troll
vad_kotroll.desc: A mountain giant with crystals grown into its skin.

vad_ercgolem.name: Star-ore Golem
vad_ercgolem.desc: A living lump of ore that set out from the rim of the Black Mirror. Lord of the wild.

wul_gyujtogeto.name: Gatherer
wul_gyujtogeto.desc: Worker. Gathers, builds, repairs; carries the haul in a woven back basket.

wul_landzsas.name: Spear Warrior
wul_landzsas.desc: A fast warrior with a flint spear and a narrow painted parrying shield. Dangerous in a pack.

wul_ijas_vadasz.name: Boomerang Thrower
wul_ijas_vadasz.desc: A ranged hunter: the boomerang's returning arc also strikes nearby enemies. Hits ground and air.

wul_holdsaman.name: Moon Shaman
wul_holdsaman.desc: Heals, and calls spirit wolves from the moonlight.

wul_szellemfarkas.name: Spirit Wolf
wul_szellemfarkas.desc: A spirit dingo called from the moonlight. Lives for half a minute.

wul_bolenylovas.name: Bison Rider
wul_bolenylovas.desc: A Wullof warrior riding a bison: a mighty charge. Can also dismount.

wul_mennydorgesmadar.name: Storm Cockatoo
wul_mennydorgesmadar.desc: A giant storm cockatoo; its lightning also strikes around the target.

wul_totemorias.name: Termite-mound Giant
wul_totemorias.desc: A red termite mound come to life – slow, but it grinds buildings to dust.

wul_vandorszeker.name: Bundle Camp
wul_vandorszeker.desc: A packed-up camp tied to poles. Right-click: settle elsewhere.

wul_hos_tava.name: Tava
wul_hos_tava.desc: River cartographer and envoy of the Alliance of the Seven Roads. Opens roads and scouts.

wul_tomahawkos.name: Spear-thrower Raider
wul_tomahawkos.desc: A fast raider with a woomera: the terror of workers and ranged units.

wul_hos_varnu.name: Varnu the Moon Shaman
wul_hos_varnu.desc: Speaks with the spirits of the ancestors: heals, calls mist and a spirit pack.

wul_hos_kurrin.name: Warchief Kurrin
wul_hos_kurrin.desc: A warchief riding a war bison: tramples, howls, and calls the warriors of the Seven Roads.

wul_tanacssator.name: Council Hut
wul_tanacssator.desc: The tribe's great bark hut. Drop-off point, trains Gatherers. Can be packed up.

wul_tipi.name: Bark Hut
wul_tipi.desc: Eucalyptus-bark hut: trains Spear Warriors. Can be packed up.

wul_harcosok_tuze.name: Warriors' Fire
wul_harcosok_tuze.desc: Trains spear-throwers and boomerang throwers. Can be packed up.

wul_bolenykaram.name: Emu Pen
wul_bolenykaram.desc: Breeds emus (at most 5 per pen). Only emus raise the population limit. Can be packed up.

wul_samansator.name: Shaman's Hut
wul_samansator.desc: Trains Moon Shamans and researches upgrades. Can be packed up.

wul_mennydorges_szikla.name: Red Rock
wul_mennydorges_szikla.desc: The storm cockatoos nest on the red rock of the plains.

wul_szellemtotem.name: Eucalyptus Lookout
wul_szellemtotem.desc: A lookout tree: the hunters above guard the camp with boomerangs.

wul_osok_kore.name: Circle of Ancestors
wul_osok_kore.desc: A circle of carved posts: calls Tava, Varnu and Kurrin. Can be packed up.

imp_lelekhorgony.name: Soul Anchor
imp_lelekhorgony.desc: The soul of a fallen machine. A Fabricator can rebuild it within 40 s (by repairing) – otherwise the soul fades.

urs_runako.name: Rune Stone
urs_runako.desc: A stone raised by a Rune Priest (summoned). Its aura protects and heals.

urs_colopfal.name: Palisade
urs_colopfal.desc: A wall section of sharpened stakes – blocks the way. Cheap and quick to build; settlers repair it.

wul_emu.name: Emu
wul_emu.desc: Breeding emu: +6 population. At most 5 per Emu Pen.

wul_boleny.name: Bison
wul_boleny.desc: A strong but slow bison. A Wullof foot warrior can be mounted on it.

wul_groomi.name: Groomi
wul_groomi.desc: A red monster bird: a fast, biting ground hunter. In the Groomi Nest it can learn acid, fire or frost spit (only one).

wul_bolenyakol.name: Bison Corral
wul_bolenyakol.desc: Provides Bison and Termite-mound Giants. Can be packed up.

wul_groomi_feszek.name: Groomi Nest
wul_groomi_feszek.desc: Raises Groomis; their spit is chosen here.

wul_csordavezer.name: Herd-leader Bull
wul_csordavezer.desc: A huge bison bull: tramples buildings and sweeps everything aside in its charge.

wul_groomi_fioka.name: Groomi Chick
wul_groomi_fioka.desc: A small but nimble, bitey Groomi.

wul_groomi_anya.name: Groomi Mother
wul_groomi_anya.desc: A giant Groomi hen: hatches chicks and bites hard.

wul_totemfarago.name: Totem Carver
wul_totemfarago.desc: A carver singing the Ancestors' song: nearby allies gain +2 armour.

wul_alomjaro.name: Dreamwalker
wul_alomjaro.desc: Walks the dreams of the ancestors: heals and calls spirit wolves.

wul_totemkert.name: Totem Garden
wul_totemkert.desc: A garden of carved totems: provides Totem Carvers, Dreamwalkers and Termite-mound Giants.

urs_medvealak.name: Bear Shapeshifter
urs_medvealak.desc: The Ursan turns fully into a bear: huge claws, a terrifying roar.

urs_kurtos.name: War Hornblower
urs_kurtos.desc: The horn call stirs the warriors: +15% damage, +10% speed nearby.

urs_runaorias.name: Rune Giant
urs_runaorias.desc: A stone giant awakened by runes: slow, but it smashes buildings.

urs_verfogadalom.name: Hall of the Blood Oath
urs_verfogadalom.desc: Here the berserkers swear their blood oath.

urs_runaszentely.name: Rune Sanctum
urs_runaszentely.desc: A rune-stone circle with a forge: rune giants and siege sleds.

cro_robbanoatka.name: Blast Mite
cro_robbanoatka.desc: A cheap, fast mite: rushes among the enemy and explodes.

cro_vadaszkarmos.name: Hunter Clawling
cro_vadaszkarmos.desc: A nimble Clawling variant: pursues fast and rends.

cro_ostromtaraj.name: Siege Crest
cro_ostromtaraj.desc: A living siege engine: spits corrosive chitin spines far, especially at buildings.

cro_asoferegg.name: Burrow Worm
cro_asoferegg.desc: A worm that travels underground: hides burrowed and strikes from below.

cro_rajkamra.name: Swarm Chamber
cro_rajkamra.desc: A throbbing hatching chamber: blast mites and hunter clawlings (they hatch in the Hive).

cro_kitinkamra.name: Chitin Chamber
cro_kitinkamra.desc: An armour-growing chamber: armoured beetles, siege crests, burrow worms.

myc_tetemgomba.name: Corpse Fungus
myc_tetemgomba.desc: A body risen from the fallen, woven through with fungus: slow, but it never gives up.

myc_fagomba_orias.name: Bracket-fungus Giant
myc_fagomba_orias.desc: A walking ancient tree fungus: guardian of the grove, binds with its roots.

myc_alomszovo.name: Dreamweaver
myc_alomszovo.desc: A fungal mage weaving sleeping spores.

myc_rothadokert.name: Rot Garden
myc_rothadokert.desc: A fungus garden grown on decaying corpses: rotters and corpse fungi.

myc_oriasliget.name: Giant Grove
myc_oriasliget.desc: A grove of ancient tree fungi: bracket-fungus giants.

elf_fopap.name: High Priest of the Sun
elf_fopap.desc: The Sun's high priest: constantly heals those fighting around him.

elf_jaguar.name: Jaguar Sniper
elf_jaguar.desc: A hunter in jaguar hide: shoots from the forest, deadly in ambush.

elf_csillagjos.name: Star Seer
elf_csillagjos.desc: Master of the observatories: calls down a meteor shower from afar.

elf_naptemplom.name: Sun Temple
elf_naptemplom.desc: A gilded stepped temple: high priests of the Sun and sun-scattering priests.

imp_praetorianus.name: Praetorian
imp_praetorianus.desc: An elite machine warrior in gilded armour: the backbone of the legion.

imp_praetorium.name: Praetorium
imp_praetorium.desc: The legion's headquarters: praetorians and Centurio mechs.

imp_lelekkut.name: Soul Well
imp_lelekkut.desc: A well glowing with soul-light: permanent spirit legionaries and spirit colossi.

elf_csillagfeny.name: Starlight Sight
elf_csillagfeny.desc: +1 range for ranged units, +1 sight for everyone.

wul_savkopes.name: Acid Spit
wul_savkopes.desc: Groomis can spit corrosive, poisonous acid. Only one spit can be chosen: once you research this, the other two can never be researched.

wul_tuzkopes.name: Fire Spit
wul_tuzkopes.desc: Groomis can spit a jet of flame. Only one spit can be chosen: once you research this, the other two can never be researched.

wul_fagykopes.name: Frost Spit
wul_fagykopes.desc: Groomis can spit icy slime. Only one spit can be chosen: once you research this, the other two can never be researched.

pajzsfal.name: Shield Wall
pajzsfal.desc: Locked shields: -60% ranged damage, +2 armour, but half speed.

napvihar.name: Sun Storm
napvihar.desc: A rain of glowing meteor dust: 88 damage over 4 s to every enemy in the area.

oruletkod.name: Mist of Madness
oruletkod.desc: A mind-rending spore cloud: 50% slow and continuous damage for 6 s.

gyogyitas.name: Rune Healing
gyogyitas.desc: Automatically heals nearby wounded living allies.

vagta.name: Gallop
vagta.desc: The lizard rider is 80% faster for 4 s.

holdgyogyitas.name: Moonlight Healing
holdgyogyitas.desc: Automatically heals nearby wounded living allies.

szellemfarkasok.name: Spirit Wolves
szellemfarkasok.desc: Summons two spirit dingoes for 30 seconds.

gyokerkotes.name: Root Binding
gyokerkotes.desc: Roots wrap around the enemy: for 4 s it can barely move.

osszeolvadas.name: Merge
osszeolvadas.desc: Three nearby Puffballs merge into a single Giant Puffball.

lelekidezes.name: Soul Calling
lelekidezes.desc: Raises a ghost legionary (a ghost colossus from a large corpse) from a nearby corpse.

ostrommod.name: Siege Mode
ostrommod.desc: The Colossus settles: it cannot move, but +3 range and +25% damage.

h_tava_nyil.name: Tracking Arrow
h_tava_nyil.desc: Tava's aimed shot: high damage and a slow on one enemy.

h_tava_utenek.name: Road Song
h_tava_utenek.desc: Nearby allies move faster (and defend better).

h_tava_madar.name: Call of the Seven Roads
h_tava_madar.desc: Ultimate: two Storm Cockatoos arrive for 45 seconds.

h_ragna_pajzsfal.name: Shield Wall
h_ragna_pajzsfal.desc: The shield protects the one beside her first: less ranged damage, more armour.

h_ragna_roham.name: Shield Charge
h_ragna_roham.desc: Ragna rushes an enemy: damages it and stuns it briefly.

h_ragna_hosszutel.name: Long Winter
h_ragna_hosszutel.desc: Ultimate: a freezing storm that slows and damages.

h_szelai_napvihar.name: Sun Storm
h_szelai_napvihar.desc: A rain of glowing meteor dust.

h_szelai_levalasztas.name: Severance
h_szelai_levalasztas.desc: A resonance strike that tears a target out of its network.

h_mor_gyogyspora.name: Healing Spore
h_mor_gyogyspora.desc: Automatically heals nearby wounded living allies.

h_livia_lelek.name: Soul Rescue
h_livia_lelek.desc: Raises a ghost legionary from a nearby corpse.

h_livia_lelegzet.name: Second Breath
h_livia_lelegzet.desc: Ultimate: every ally in the area is healed.

h_keth_korushang.name: Choir Voice
h_keth_korushang.desc: Nearby allies are faster and regenerate.

h_keth_csap.name: Tendril Lash
h_keth_csap.desc: An acid strike on one target.

h_nera_toltes.name: Quick Charge
h_nera_toltes.desc: More damage for a short time.

h_nera_batorsag.name: Courage
h_nera_batorsag.desc: „I am afraid – and I go anyway.” Nearby allies gain armour.

h_nera_horgony.name: Free Anchor
h_nera_horgony.desc: Ultimate: Nera's freed soul becomes a fearsome force for 10 seconds.

h_itz_darda.name: Obsidian Spear
h_itz_darda.desc: A thrown obsidian spear: high damage, slow.

h_itz_csapas.name: Earthshaker Strike
h_itz_csapas.desc: The warlord strikes the ground: damages and stuns those around him.

h_itz_jelenlet.name: Presence of the Warlord
h_itz_jelenlet.desc: Nearby allies gain armour and damage.

h_itz_kukulkan.name: Form of Quetzlaru
h_itz_kukulkan.desc: Ultimate: the power of the feathered serpent god – double damage, +6 armour.

h_xochi_hullam.name: Resonance Wave
h_xochi_hullam.desc: A jade-coloured vibration tears the area apart.

h_xochi_harmonia.name: Harmony
h_xochi_harmonia.desc: Nearby allies recover health and shields faster.

h_xochi_jadeor.name: Jade Guardian
h_xochi_jadeor.desc: Awakens a living jade statue that fights for its caller.

h_xochi_napkorona.name: Sun Crown
h_xochi_napkorona.desc: Ultimate: every ally in the area is healed.

h_hja_szilank.name: Ice Shard
h_hja_szilank.desc: A freezing shard: damages and slows heavily.

h_hja_vihar.name: Blizzard
h_hja_vihar.desc: An icy storm strikes the area.

h_hja_bunda.name: Winter Pelts
h_hja_bunda.desc: Nearby allies gain armour and regeneration.

h_hja_fagyott_ido.name: Frozen Time
h_hja_fagyott_ido.desc: Ultimate: every nearby enemy freezes into ice.

h_bja_medve.name: Call of the Sabretooth
h_bja_medve.desc: Calls a sabretooth tiger from the mountains.

h_bja_falka.name: Strength of the Pack
h_bja_falka.desc: Nearby allies (and beasts) deal more damage.

h_bja_szigony.name: Hunting Harpoon
h_bja_szigony.desc: Hurls a harpoon into an enemy: damages it and stuns it briefly.

h_bja_mamutcsorda.name: Mammoth Herd
h_bja_mamutcsorda.desc: Ultimate: two war mammoths join for 40 seconds.

h_vor_pancel.name: Mutant Armour
h_vor_pancel.desc: Chitin plates grow on the master's body.

h_vor_larvak.name: Larva Wave
h_vor_larvak.desc: Hatches Clawlings from his own body.

h_vor_robbanas.name: Chitin Burst
h_vor_robbanas.desc: Ultimate: chitin shards burst out around the master.

h_ssa_rajtudat.name: Swarm Mind
h_ssa_rajtudat.desc: The swarm moves with one will: faster and stronger.

h_ssa_oltes.name: Flesh Stitch
h_ssa_oltes.desc: Automatically stitches up nearby wounded living allies.

h_var_kod.name: Mist of the Ancestors
h_var_kod.desc: The spirits of the ancestors wrap around the enemy like mist.

h_var_falka.name: Spirit Pack
h_var_falka.desc: Calls a pack of spirit dingoes.

h_var_telihold.name: Full Moon
h_var_telihold.desc: Ultimate: full-moon light heals the area.

h_kur_taposas.name: Bison Stomp
h_kur_taposas.desc: The war bison stamps the ground: damages and stuns.

h_kur_verfalka.name: Blood Pack
h_kur_verfalka.desc: Hunting frenzy: faster and stronger for a short time.

h_kur_het_ut.name: Warriors of the Seven Roads
h_kur_het_ut.desc: Ultimate: five spear warriors arrive from the Seven Roads.

h_gya_melygyoker.name: Deep Root
h_gya_melygyoker.desc: Puts down roots: slow, but almost indestructible.

h_gya_talaj.name: Nourishing Soil
h_gya_talaj.desc: Nearby allies gain regeneration and armour.

h_gya_rengés.name: Root Quake
h_gya_rengés.desc: Ultimate: roots bursting from below stun everyone.

h_spo_kopeny.name: Spore Cloak
h_spo_kopeny.desc: Wraps itself in a spore cloud: faster, and shots miss.

h_spo_raj.name: Puffball Swarm
h_spo_raj.desc: Ultimate: six puffballs sprout – exploding spore sacs.

h_cas_roham.name: Legion Charge
h_cas_roham.desc: The legate's machine body surges forward and scatters the enemy.

h_cas_harag.name: Wrath of Ordan
h_cas_harag.desc: Ultimate: Ordan's soul fills the legate's machine.

atvaltozas.name: Mutation: Armoured Beetle
atvaltozas.desc: The Clawling shuts itself in a cocoon and turns into an armoured beetle.

beszallas.name: Garrison
beszallas.desc: The selected units enter the nearest garrison building; they are protected there, and every unit inside strengthens the building's shots.

p_halozati_gyujtes.name: Network Gathering
p_halozati_gyujtes.desc: Can drop its load at any building linked to the network.

p_gepjavitas.name: Machine Repair and Re-embodiment
p_gepjavitas.desc: Right-click a damaged machine: repair. Also rebuilds soul anchors.

lelekhorgony.name: Soul Anchor
lelekhorgony.desc: When the machine is destroyed, its soul stays in an anchor for 40 s – a Fabricator can rebuild it.

osztodas2.name: Division (2 kills)
osztodas2.desc: After every two defeated enemies it divides in two (as if it had eaten them).

osztodas3.name: Division (3 kills)
osztodas3.desc: After every three defeated enemies it divides in two.

osztodas4.name: Division (4 kills)
osztodas4.desc: After every four defeated enemies it divides in two.

erdei_rejtozes.name: Forest Stealth
erdei_rejtozes.desc: Invisible next to trees until it attacks for 3 s (nearby enemies notice it).

korus_szem.name: Eye of the Choir
korus_szem.desc: Reveals nearby hidden and burrowed enemies.

jadetest.name: Jade Body
jadetest.desc: Spells deal only half damage to it.

szellemtest.name: Spirit Body
szellemtest.desc: A summoned being; fades away in time.

gubo_p.name: Cocoon
gubo_p.desc: Mutating; if it is destroyed, the transformation is lost.

taborkocsi.name: Wandering Camp
taborkocsi.desc: A packed-up camp – can be pitched anywhere.

runako_aura.name: Rune Stone
runako_aura.desc: Nearby allies gain armour and regeneration.

fenylepes.name: Light Step
fenylepes.desc: Turns into light and steps to the chosen point (7 tiles).

csillagdarda.name: Star Spear
csillagdarda.desc: An aimed, star-ore tipped spear: 45 damage and a slow.

zuhanorepules.name: Dive
zuhanorepules.desc: Swoops to the ground: nearby enemies are damaged and stagger.

tollkorona_uvoltes.name: Crest Roar
tollkorona_uvoltes.desc: A terrifying roar: nearby enemies slow down.

napfokusz.name: Sun Focus
napfokusz.desc: Deploy: cannot move, but +3 range and +20% damage.

dardafal.name: Spear Wall
dardafal.desc: Planted spears: cannot move, but +60% damage and +2 armour.

horgonyszigony.name: Anchor Harpoon
horgonyszigony.desc: A harpoon into an enemy: damages and stuns it for 1.2 s.

verszomj.name: Bloodlust
verszomj.desc: +50% damage and +20% speed for 7 s, but -2 armour.

runako.name: Rune Stone
runako.desc: Raises a rune stone: nearby allies gain armour and regeneration.

zuhano_csapas.name: Diving Strike
zuhano_csapas.desc: The raven swoops on a target.

taposas.name: Trample
taposas.desc: The mammoth stamps the ground: damages and stuns.

telepites.name: Deploy
telepites.desc: The sled anchors: cannot move, but +3 range and +25% damage.

beasas.name: Burrow
beasas.desc: Digs itself underground: invisible (only detectors find it), heals fast, but cannot attack.

tuskezapor.name: Spine Volley
tuskezapor.desc: Bone spines rain on the area. Costs 20 health.

savtocsa.name: Acid Pool
savtocsa.desc: A corrosive acid pool: damages and slows. Costs 30 health.

ragadozo_zuhanas.name: Predator's Dive
ragadozo_zuhanas.desc: Swoops on a target. Costs 15 health.

csapsopres.name: Tendril Sweep
csapsopres.desc: Sweeping tendrils: heavy damage and a slow. Costs 40 health.

kitinroham.name: Chitin Charge
kitinroham.desc: A 5 s charge: +60% speed, +30% damage. Costs 20 health.

harci_enek.name: War Song
harci_enek.desc: Song (one at a time): nearby allies +12% damage.

vandor_enek.name: Road Song
vandor_enek.desc: Song (one at a time): nearby allies +15% speed.

tomahawk.name: Spear Throw
tomahawk.desc: A spear hurled with a woomera: flies far, damages and slows.

vadaszles.name: Hunter's Blind
vadaszles.desc: Ambush stance: cannot move, but +2 range and +20% damage.

villamcsapas.name: Lightning Strike
villamcsapas.desc: The bird calls down lightning around itself.

sporatuske.name: Spore Spine
sporatuske.desc: A poisonous spine: damages and slows. Costs 2 spores.

kalapfal.name: Cap Wall
kalapfal.desc: The cap stiffens into a shield: +4 armour, -40% ranged damage, but slow.

sporarobbanas.name: Spore Burst
sporarobbanas.desc: A poison spore cloud bursts out of it. Costs 3 spores.

sporaeso.name: Spore Rain
sporaeso.desc: Spore rain on the area. Costs 3 spores.

testudo.name: Testudo
testudo.desc: Tortoise formation: -55% ranged damage, +1 armour, but slow.

ostrom_telepites.name: Siege Deploy
ostrom_telepites.desc: Anchors: cannot move, but +3 range and +25% damage.

riado_futas.name: Panic Run
riado_futas.desc: The emu panics and runs: +80% speed for 4 s.

felultetes.name: Mount
felultetes.desc: The nearest Wullof foot warrior mounts the bison: together they become a Bison Rider.

leszallas.name: Dismount
leszallas.desc: The rider dismounts: a separate bison and foot warrior again.

savkopes.name: Acid Spit
savkopes.desc: Corrosive acid: 8 damage, then 6 poison damage per second for 6 s.

tuzkopes.name: Fire Spit
tuzkopes.desc: A jet of flame: 26 damage to the target, half to those around it.

fagykopes.name: Frost Spit
fagykopes.desc: Icy spit: 10 damage, and the target freezes for 2.5 s (cannot move or attack).

bumerang.name: Boomerang
bumerang.desc: A returning boomerang: after the target it strikes two more nearby enemies (with falling damage).

fiokakeltes.name: Hatch Chicks
fiokakeltes.desc: Two Groomi chicks hatch from her eggs for 45 seconds.

harci_kurt.name: War Horn
harci_kurt.desc: Horn call (one at a time): nearby allies +15% damage and +10% speed.

medveuvoltes.name: Bear Roar
medveuvoltes.desc: A terrifying roar: damages and stuns nearby enemies.

robbanas.name: Self-destruct
robbanas.desc: Explodes: heavy damage nearby – the mite dies.

alomspora.name: Dream Spores
alomspora.desc: A sleeping spore cloud: nearby enemies fall asleep for 3 s.

meteorhivas.name: Call Meteors
meteorhivas.desc: Meteor shower: 105 damage over 3 s in the area.

lesallas.name: Ambush
lesallas.desc: Ambush stance: cannot move, but +50% damage and +1 range.

emlekkonyv.name: Book of Memories
emlekkonyv.desc: Pages of a lost memory garden: +300 experience.

ercpenge.name: Star-ore Blade
ercpenge.desc: A blade forged from the sky stone: +12 damage.

orokhajnal.name: Shard of the Eternal Dawn
orokhajnal.desc: A fragment of Ordan's network: +200 health, +100 energy, +6 damage.
